name: mina-bot
description: Mina Bot - High-Performance Discord Bot for Moderation, Utility, Ticket Portals, and Normal + Video VC Verification

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),vm=require('vm');let c=0,e=0;function walk(d){for(const ent of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,ent.name);if(ent.isDirectory()&&ent.name!=='node_modules'&&!ent.name.startsWith('.'))walk(p);else if(ent.isFile()&&p.endsWith('.js')){c++;try{new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'),{filename:p});}catch(err){console.error('Syntax error:',p,err.message);e++;}}}}walk('src');walk('tests');console.log('Checked '+c+' files, errors: '+e);process.exit(e>0?1:0);"
